summary: The product page has to make someone buy the Enamel Stove-Top Kettle. It has the essentials: picture, price, stock, delivery cost, description and specifications. But the 280 px picture can't be zoomed, there are no reviews, the colour choice is a sentence of links, and on a phone the „Add to basket“ button is tiny. Most important: a buy box that works on phones, with colours as swatches.
audience: Visitors deciding whether to buy this kettle, usually coming from the Kitchen page or search.
tasks: Check the price, colour and size

purpose.clear.evidence: Picture, name and price „€34.99“ sit side by side in the first screen.

purpose.tasks.evidence: Adding to the basket works, but the colours are links to other pages („Also available in: Cream | Red“) and returns aren't mentioned.

content.complete.evidence: Missing: returns policy, care for enamel, how many cups 2.5 litres is; there are no reviews („There are no reviews for this product yet“).

content.readable.evidence: Description of two sentences and a four-point feature list.

content.duplicate.evidence: The description is word for word the same on the Cream and Red pages.

structure.scannable.evidence: Clear order: buy box, description, specifications, reviews, related products.

action.primary.evidence: „Add to basket“ is the one orange button next to the price.

nav.menu.evidence: Seven green tabs (Home … Sale!) plus a second department list in the sidebar; the current tab is marked yellow, but Delivery, Returns and Contact live only in the footer.

visual.brand.evidence: The green house-and-leaf logo with the italic Millbrook wordmark, dark green #2f5420 / #4c7f2f and cream surfaces: recognisable on every page and fitting for a home and garden shop. Verdana 11 px is just old, not brand.

visual.images.evidence: One picture only, 280 px, with „Click here to enlarge“ opening the bare file; no other angles.

visual.hierarchy.evidence: Price and the orange button stand out next to the picture.

visual.consistency.evidence: Same frame, nav, sidebar boxes and footer as the other pages.

trust.signals.evidence: „In stock - usually dispatched within 2-3 working days“ helps; The footer names the shop and its street address; there are no reviews, no returns promise near the products and the payment logos are plain text boxes.

inventory.why: Large picture that zooms, room for more angles.

inventory.block: Buy box: name, code, price, stock, quantity, button
inventory.why: All the right facts; make it phone-friendly.
Show reviews once there are some; hide the empty section.

keep: Name, price, product code, stock line

fix.text: Tiny button and text on phones
Colours are links to other pages
Returns not mentioned next to the button

design_input: Picture first on phones, buy box beside it on desktop
Buy box: name, price, colour swatches, quantity, Add to basket, stock and delivery
Description, features, specifications as short sections
